changelog: ONT WGS: the amplicon post-run steps (MaAsLin 3, DADA2 provenance) no longer run on genome results — the 'maaslin3 ERROR: asv_table.csv' at the end of a WGS log; the WGS results themselves were never affected. Shotgun (beta): species below a minimum abundance (default 0.01 % of a sample's reads, set in step 3) are left out of the tables and counted in read_tracking — a pure B. subtilis culture listed 90 species, almost all close relatives sharing k-mers; the report explains that pattern when it sees it. setup_shotgun.sh: the human host index now downloads (hostile needed the env on PATH). Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Shotgun (beta): Kraken 2 confidence now defaults to 0 (Kraken 2's own default). With 0.1 the mock test failed on nextapp — whole species lost on Illumina and almost every Nanopore read unclassified with the 16 GB index; with 0 the same mock passes on the real Standard-08 index (genus Bray-Curtis 0.039 Illumina, 0.019 Nanopore). The index is read from disk automatically when it does not fit in free memory. setup_shotgun.sh found no tools on machines whose `mamba info --base` prints a label before the path (mamba 2); fixed. Backend restart required.
